keputusan.jawaban: Yes to both, with conditions. (a) RECONSTRUCTION is C1 when the fused model (SfM/photogrammetric point cloud, SLAM map, NeRF/3DGS, row panorama or orthomosaic) is built from images taken at several positions, and fruit are detected or counted in that model or projected into it. Label it M4: the fusion puts each fruit at one place in a shared space, so this is geometric association. Add M1 only if a correction factor is actually applied (see 1.4). If the reconstruction is used only for canopy geometry and fruit are counted per image, code by what is left (C2 or C5). A 360-degree image from one position at one moment is one observation, so it is C2 or C5. (b) STATISTICAL is C1 with M1 when per-image counts or features from two or more views of the same tree or plant are combined by a rule (sum with factor, regression, learned regression or feature fusion) and no individual fruit are linked. A learned multi-view regressor (e.g. a transformer that fuses views into one count) is still M1. M5 is only for networks that output correspondences or identities between fruit. If correction is applied to one view only, the record is C2.
keputusan.aturan: Code C1 if the method takes images of the same plant from two or more positions and either (a) counts fruit in or via a model fused from those images (label M4) or (b) combines the per-view counts or features with a statistical or learned rule without linking fruit (label M1); a single-position image or a per-view-only correction is not C1.
keputusan.alasan: The C1 definition is 'combines several observations of the same fruit', not 'links individual fruit'. The C1 label set itself has M0 (no association) and M1 (statistical correction, multiplier or regression), so the protocol expects C1 records that never link fruit. Excluding them would leave M0/M1 empty and would hide the baseline that RQ1/RQ2 compare against. Fused reconstructions answer RQ1 directly: identity comes from shared 3D or mosaic coordinates (M4), and the acquisition each one assumes is what RQ1 asks about. Examples: hong2025 (3DGS), yuan2024 (SLAM map), tureckova2022 (row panorama stitched from video frames; the authors say every fruit appears once) and kutyrev2025 (orthophoto) fit (a). qian2013 (east and west images, regression on summed counts), scalisi2021 (both sides scanned, calibration factor), li2023 (three views, regression) and isobe2025 (learned fusion across 360-degree views) fit (b).

keputusan.jawaban: A dataset paper with no counting method of its own is C1 with mechanism DATA alone, provided the released data hold several observations of the same fruit plus ground truth that ties them together: fruit positions in one common or global frame, shared fruit IDs across images or scans, or true per-tree counts. If the data are multi-modal or 3D but have no cross-view link (one view per fruit), the record is C5 with no mechanism. Both examples are C1 DATA. Fuji-SfM gives 2D masks for an image motion sequence plus 3D apple positions in global coordinates. LFuji-air gives 8 scans per tree from different sensor positions plus apple locations in world coordinates.
keputusan.aturan: Code a dataset-only paper C1 with mechanism DATA if it releases two or more images or scans of the same fruit together with ground truth that links them (common 3D positions, shared fruit IDs, or true per-tree counts); otherwise code it by modality (C5 for depth/3D/non-RGB, C2 for single-view counting data).
keputusan.alasan: DATA is in the C1 mechanism vocabulary, so the protocol foresees C1 records whose contribution is data. RQ2 asks how evidence on double counting and missed fruit is measured, and datasets with cross-view identity ground truth are the measurement base for that evidence. E5 does not fit: it is aimed at detection methods with no evaluation, and these papers provide the evaluation material itself. The linking ground truth is what separates a cross-view dataset from a plain 3D detection dataset (C5).

keputusan.jawaban: Yes, C1 with M3 (tracking). Linking fruit identity across video frames is the cross-view mechanism RQ1 asks about, wherever the reported count comes from. The condition is that the paper evaluates the tracking itself (e.g. MOTA/MOTSA, IDF1, ID switches, counts per track) or reports some count. If identity is linked but the paper evaluates neither tracking nor counting, it is E5. In the example (ariza-sentis2023), PointTrack tracks grape bunches across UAV video frames and tracking performance is reported, so it is C1 M3 (+DATA, since datasets are released). The single-frame berry-per-bunch count is noted, but it does not change the code.
keputusan.aturan: Code C1 with M3 any study that links fruit identity across video frames and reports either a tracking metric or a count, even if the count comes from one frame; if neither is reported, exclude it as E5.
keputusan.alasan: C1 is defined by combining several observations of the same fruit, and frame-to-frame tracking does exactly that. Tracking metrics (ID switches, IDF1) measure how well the mechanism avoids double counting, which is the evidence RQ2 needs, so dropping these studies would remove relevant mechanism evidence. E5 already covers the case where nothing is evaluated.

keputusan.jawaban: In general it is not a mechanism. The protocol defines the mechanism label as how the same fruit is kept from being counted twice. A visible-to-true calibration corrects missed (occluded) fruit, not duplicates. So when the count that goes into the regression has already been made unique by M2-M5 or by a fused model, do not add M1; record the calibration only as an occlusion-correction note for RQ2. The exception: if the regression input is a raw sum or combination of per-view counts that can contain duplicates, the regression is the only thing absorbing the overlap, so label it M1. In the examples, apolo-apolo2020 (orthomosaic, then linear regression) is M4. gene-mola2020 (georeferenced merged point clouds, then linear regression) is M4. nuske2014 (image registration to avoid double counting, then visibility calibration) is M4.
keputusan.aturan: Add M1 only if the regression or factor is applied to counts that have not been made unique (a raw sum or combination of per-view counts); if the input count was already made unique by M2-M5 or by fusion, do not label the calibration as a mechanism and record it only as an occlusion correction.
keputusan.alasan: The mechanism label is explicitly 'how the same fruit is prevented from being counted twice'. Labelling every occlusion calibration as M1 would make M1 mean two things and inflate it. It would also hide the difference RQ2 draws between controlling double counting and controlling missed fruit. Where duplicates and occlusion cannot be separated (a regression on summed views), the regression is the only de-duplication step, so M1 is correct there and agrees with answer 1.1(b).

keputusan.jawaban: S. Decide by the representation in which fruit are detected or counted, not by how the images were captured. If fruit are detected or counted in a 3D point cloud or 3D model (photogrammetric/SfM dense cloud, LiDAR or moving-scanner cloud, SLAM map, NeRF/3DGS), the label is S, whether the source was UAV stills, video or a scanner. When counting is done on 2D images: V for a continuous image sequence along a path (video or high-rate frames, including row panoramas stitched from video), D for discrete images from separate positions (including orthomosaics built from discrete UAV photos). T is added when the same plants are revisited at different times. All three examples are S: xiao2024 (UAV cross-circling oblique route, 3D boll point cloud), torres-sanchez2021 (UAV photogrammetric point clouds) and hobart2025 (UAV RGB dense point cloud).
keputusan.aturan: Assign S if fruit are detected or counted in a 3D point cloud or 3D model; otherwise assign V if the input is a continuous image sequence along a path and D if it is discrete images from separate positions; add T for revisits on different dates.
keputusan.alasan: RQ1 asks which acquisition conditions each mechanism assumes. A method that counts in a fused 3D cloud assumes enough coverage and overlap to reconstruct the scene, whatever the capture mode, and its association is geometric (M4). Labelling by the counting representation gives one decidable criterion, with no judgement about frame rate or overlap. It also keeps V and D for the 2D association methods (tracking, view combination), where capture continuity really changes which mechanism is possible.

keputusan.jawaban: Assess them on content, like the 27. E7 is about the language of the record available for screening, not the language of the full text. A record with an English title and abstract indexed in Scopus is screened and coded from that abstract, and for C1 the Chinese full text is used for the labels, as was done for the 27. E7 applies only when no English abstract exists (as in the one record already excluded).
keputusan.aturan: Exclude as E7 only a record that has no English-language abstract; screen and code every record with an English abstract on its content, whatever the full-text language.
keputusan.alasan: Consistency: 27 records from the same two journals were already coded on content (11 of them C1), and E7 was applied only to the record with no English abstract. Excluding the 10 pending records as E7 would treat identical records differently and add selection bias against the Chinese literature, which holds many C1 studies relevant to RQ1-RQ3. An English abstract is enough to assign inclusion codes, and the C1 labels have already been coded successfully from Chinese full texts.

keputusan.jawaban: Both (a) and (b) are C1, each with one condition. (a) RECONSTRUCTION is C1 with mechanism M4 when the fused product (SfM or photogrammetric point cloud, SLAM map, NeRF or 3DGS, stitched 360-degree panorama or orthomosaic) is built from overlapping images of the same fruit, and fruit are detected or counted in that product, or per-image detections are projected into it and de-duplicated there. If the fused model is only used for canopy geometry, georeferencing or display while fruit are counted per image, (a) does not apply: code by the per-image method (C2, or C5 for 3D or depth). (b) STATISTICAL is C1 with mechanism M1 (not M0 or M5) when per-image counts or features from two or more images of the same tree or plant, taken from different positions or angles, are combined by a formula, a regression or a learned regressor without linking individual fruit. If there is only one image per tree, or each tree side is counted and reported separately and never combined, it is C2 (C4 if per-class).
keputusan.aturan: Code C1 if the reported count or detection comes from a model or image fused from several overlapping views of the same fruit (label M4), or from a statistical or learned rule that combines counts or features from two or more views of the same tree (label M1); otherwise code by the single-view content (C2, C4 or C5).
keputusan.alasan: C1 is defined as a 'method that combines several observations of the same fruit'. Both kinds do this. The C1 mechanism list already expects both kinds: M4 is 'geometric or 3D association', which is what registration and fusion do implicitly, and M1 is 'statistical correction (multiplier or regression)', which only makes sense as a C1 mechanism if statistical combination counts as C1. RQ1 and RQ2 need these records so that implicit (fusion) and non-identity (statistical) strategies can be compared with explicit tracking. All 8 examples follow the rule. Hong 2025 (3DGS from 400 images), Yuan 2024 (RGB-D SLAM map), Tureckova 2022 (panorama stitched from 360 video; the paper says this replaces tracking), and Kutyrev 2025 (detection on tiles of a Metashape orthomosaic, with de-duplication across tile overlaps) are C1/M4. Qian 2013 (sum of patches from two directions, then regression), Li 2023 (three views, then regression), Isobe 2025 (transformer regressor fusing frames from 360 video; the paper says it uses no tracking), and Scalisi 2021 (both sides scanned, per-image detections scaled by a regression calibration factor, no association described) are C1/M1. No example failed the rule.

keputusan.jawaban: Yes, C1 with mechanism DATA alone, but only when the released data contain several observations of the same fruit with fruit-level ground truth that is shared across those observations (3D fruit positions in a common frame that the images or scans map to, or identity tracks across frames). If the dataset has only single-view images, or only one scan per tree, code it by its content as if it were a method: C5 for 3D, depth or non-RGB data, C2 for single-view count annotations, C3 for oil palm. If it has no fruit annotations, exclude it as E5.
keputusan.aturan: A dataset paper without its own counting method is C1 (mechanism DATA only) if it releases two or more images or scans of the same fruit together with fruit-level ground truth that links them (shared 3D positions or track IDs); otherwise apply the normal codes to the data content.
keputusan.alasan: DATA is in the C1 mechanism list, so the protocol expects C1 records whose contribution is a dataset. RQ2 asks how evidence on double counting and missed fruit is measured, and multi-view data with cross-view ground truth is the benchmark that makes this measurable. A single-view dataset cannot test cross-view identity, so it belongs to the modality codes. Fuji-SfM (582 motion-sequence images, SfM point cloud, apple positions in global coordinates) and LFuji-air (8 LiDAR scans per tree from different positions, 3D boxes for each apple in a global frame) both meet the condition, so both are C1/DATA.

keputusan.jawaban: Yes, C1 with mechanism M3 (acquisition V), when fruit identity is linked across frames and the paper reports any quantitative evaluation (tracking metrics such as MOTA, MOTSA, IDF1 or ID switches, or counts, or measurements). Record in the RQ2 extraction that the count is single-frame or absent. If the tracking has no evaluation at all, exclude it as E5.
keputusan.aturan: Code C1 (M3) whenever the method links fruit identity across frames, regardless of whether the reported count comes from the tracks, a single frame, or is absent, provided some quantitative result is reported; otherwise E5.
keputusan.alasan: C1 is defined by combining several observations of the same fruit, not by the type of count reported. Linking identity across frames is exactly the mechanism RQ1 asks about. The priority rule gives C1 precedence for such studies. Tracking metrics such as ID switches are direct RQ2 evidence on association errors that cause double counting. E5 only covers 'detection without counting or other evaluation', and tracking metrics are an evaluation. Ariza-Sentis 2023 tracks grape bunches in UAV video with PointTrack and reports MOTSA, sMOTSA and ID switches, while berry counts come per bunch in single images. It is therefore C1/M3, V.

keputusan.jawaban: Not a mechanism when the record already removes duplicates by another mechanism (tracking, registration or 3D fusion, re-ID). In that case the visible-to-true regression only corrects occlusion (missed fruit): record it as an occlusion-correction note for RQ2 and do not add M1. Label it M1 only when that regression is the only step that turns counts from several overlapping images into one count, so that it absorbs double counting as well (this is the (b) case of 1.1).
keputusan.aturan: Add M1 for a calibration regression only if no other mechanism in the paper prevents the same fruit from being counted twice across images; if another mechanism (M2 to M5) does that, record the regression as occlusion correction and leave it out of the mechanism label.
keputusan.alasan: The protocol defines a mechanism as 'how the same fruit is prevented from being counted twice'. Occlusion calibration addresses fruit that are never seen, which is the missed-fruit side of RQ2, not identity. Adding M1 to every record with a yield calibration would make M1 near-universal and hide the real association method. Checked against the examples: Nuske 2014 registers berries to vine positions by visual odometry to avoid double counting between consecutive images, then applies 'visibility calibration', so it is M4 without M1. Gené-Mola 2020 (LiDAR) merges georeferenced E and W scans into one point cloud before detection, then fits y = a·x + b, so it is M4 without M1. Apolo-Apolo 2020 counts on an orthomosaic and then regresses visible to total because only top views are visible, so it is M4 without M1. Scalisi 2021 (see 1.1) has no other de-duplication, so its calibration factor is M1.

keputusan.jawaban: Code the acquisition by what the field sensor records, not by the derived product. S applies only when the sensor itself measures range or depth (LiDAR or mobile laser scanner, RGB-D, ToF, or a moving stereo rig). For RGB-only capture: V if the input is a continuous video stream along a path (including video-SfM or visual SLAM from RGB video), D if it is discrete still images from separate positions (UAV photogrammetry surveys, handheld photo sets for SfM, NeRF or 3DGS). The fused point cloud is already captured by the mechanism label (M4). Add T if the same plants are revisited at different dates.
keputusan.aturan: Label S if the sensor measures depth (LiDAR, RGB-D, ToF, stereo rig); otherwise V if the images are frames of a continuous video, otherwise D; never assign S only because a point cloud was computed from RGB images.
keputusan.alasan: RQ1 asks which acquisition conditions each mechanism assumes. If every photogrammetric cloud were labelled S, acquisition would just repeat M4 and the map could not show that 3D association works from cheap RGB stills, from video, or only from active scanners. The capture-based rule keeps the two axes independent and leaves no room for judgement. The 'or point cloud' in S is read as a point cloud delivered by a 3D sensor. This departs from a purely literal reading of the definition, hence medium confidence. Examples: Xiao 2024 (UAV waypoint photos, 30 per circle, SfM) is D. Torres-Sánchez 2021 (UAV photogrammetric clouds from flights) is D. Hobart 2025 (UAV RGB dense cloud from photo flights, 2018 and 2020 seasons) is D, and D+T if the seasons are treated as revisits. For comparison, Yuan 2024 (RGB-D SLAM) and Gené-Mola 2020 (LiDAR) are S, Hong 2025 (400 still images) is D, and Isobe 2025 (360 video) is V.

keputusan.jawaban: Assess them on content like the 27 already included; do not exclude them as E7. Apply E7 only when no English title and abstract exist. When a C1 code needs full-text detail, code it from the Chinese full text (machine translation allowed), as was done for the 11 C1 records.
keputusan.aturan: Exclude as E7 only a record with no English abstract; a record with an English title and abstract is screened and coded on content whatever the full-text language, using the (translated) full text when C1 labels need it.
keputusan.alasan: Consistency: 27 records from the same two journals were screened, coded across C1, C2, C4, C5 and R, and included on the basis of their English abstracts. Excluding 10 similar records as E7 would apply two different eligibility rules to identical cases and bias the map against a major source of Chinese agricultural engineering work. The only E7 record set so far had a Chinese-only abstract, so the rule already in practice is 'no English abstract means E7'. Since screening runs on title and abstract, having an English abstract is the criterion a screener can apply.

keputusan.jawaban: Both (a) and (b) are C1. (a) RECONSTRUCTION gets C1 with mechanism M4. This covers SfM or photogrammetric point clouds, SLAM maps, NeRF or 3DGS, and 360-degree panoramas or orthomosaics stitched from many frames. (b) STATISTICAL gets C1 with mechanism M1. Two conditions apply. First, for (a) the fruit must be detected or counted in the fused model, or via projection into it. If the fused model is used only for canopy geometry or tree location, and fruit are counted per image, the record is coded by its other content (C2/C5) and is not C1 through reconstruction. Second, for (b) the counts from at least two images of the same plant (two sides, several angles, several views) must be combined into one per-plant count. A plain sum with no correction is C1 with M0. Counts per view that are reported but never combined, or one image per tree with a correction factor, are C2. Learned regression that combines views without linking single fruit (e.g. the transformer fusion over 360-degree video in isobe2025) is M1, not M5.
keputusan.aturan: Code C1 if fruit are counted in or via a model fused from images taken at several positions (label M4), or if counts from two or more images of the same plant are combined into one per-plant count by a statistical or learned rule without linking fruit (label M1; a plain uncorrected sum is M0); otherwise code by the remaining content (C2 for one image per plant, C5 for one stereo pair or one 3D capture).
keputusan.alasan: For C1: the C1 definition is 'combines several observations of the same fruit (video, several views, repeated scans)'. A fused 3D model or mosaic does exactly that, because registration merges every view of a fruit into one location. This is the geometric association that M4 describes. For (b), the protocol's own C1 mechanism list contains M1 'statistical correction (multiplier factor or regression)' and M0 'no association across images'. Those labels only make sense if multi-view records without fruit-level linking are C1. RQ1 and RQ2 also need these statistical baselines so that explicit association can be compared against them. Against C2 or C5: C2 is defined as 'single view' and does not fit images from several positions. C5 fits only one capture (the stereo rule treats one stereo pair as one observation). Reconstructions from many positions are the multi-position case, so the stereo rule makes them C1 by analogy. Priority: when C5 also fits a 3D reconstruction, C1 wins. Checks against the examples: yuan2024 (SLAM map) and hong2025 (3DGS point cloud) give C1 M4. tureckova2022 counts on a panorama stitched from 360-degree video frames, and kutyrev2025 counts on an orthophotomap built in Metashape and removes duplicates where tiles overlap; both give C1 M4. qian2013 (bilateral images) and scalisi2021 (scans of both sides with a calibration factor) give C1 M1. li2023 (three views plus a regression) and isobe2025 (learned fusion of views) give C1 M1.

keputusan.jawaban: These records are C1 with mechanism DATA alone, provided the dataset holds several observations of the same fruit. Examples are a motion sequence, scans from several positions, or revisits, with annotations that let a user link or locate each fruit across those observations (3D positions in global coordinates, track IDs, or per-tree ground-truth counts). A dataset of single images or single stereo pairs is coded by its content (C5 or C2 if it qualifies). If it has no evaluation or counting annotation, it is E5.
keputusan.aturan: A dataset paper without its own counting method is C1 with mechanism DATA if it releases two or more images or scans of the same fruit from different positions or times, together with fruit-level ground truth (3D location, identity, or per-plant count); otherwise code it by its content, and use E5 if it has no counting or evaluation annotation.
keputusan.alasan: For C1 DATA: DATA is listed among the C1 labels, so the protocol expects C1 records whose contribution is a dataset. RQ2 asks how the evidence on double counting and missed fruit is measured, and multi-view benchmarks with fruit-level ground truth are the instruments for that measurement. Against E5: E5 targets detection methods that report no counting or evaluation, not resources built for evaluation. Excluding these records would remove the benchmarks that RQ2 must name. Against C5: C5 describes detection from one capture. These datasets are by design multi-position or multi-scan, so the stereo-rule logic puts them on the C1 side. Checks against the examples: genemola2020fuji releases 582 motion-sequence images, an SfM point cloud and 3D apple positions in global coordinates, so it is C1 DATA. genemola2020lfuji releases 8 LiDAR scans per tree from different sensor positions with apple location ground truth, intended for studying multi-view effects, so it is C1 DATA. Each dataset also points to a companion method paper, and that paper is coded separately.

keputusan.jawaban: Yes, it is C1 with mechanism M3 and acquisition V. The condition is that the paper evaluates the cross-frame linking (e.g. MOTA/MOTSA, IDF1, ID switches, track-level counts) or uses the tracks for any output. Where the reported count comes from does not matter. If tracking is only mentioned, or is applied with no evaluation of identity linking, code the record by the rest of its content.
keputusan.aturan: Code C1 (M3, plus any other labels that apply) when fruit identity is linked across frames or views and the linking is evaluated or used, even if the reported count comes from a single frame or no count is reported; per RQ2 the evidence field records the association metric.
keputusan.alasan: For C1: the topic is cross-view identity. RQ1 asks for the mechanisms that decide that observations are the same fruit, and frame-to-frame tracking is such a mechanism (M3). RQ2 asks how well each mechanism controls double counting and how this is measured, and identity-switch metrics measure this directly. The stereo rule makes C1 depend on 'fruit are linked across frames', not on the count output, which is a direct precedent. Against C2: C2 assumes a single-view study, and a single-frame count does not cancel the multi-frame linking. Against E5: E5 needs 'no counting or other evaluation', but a tracking evaluation is an evaluation. Check against the example: arizasentis2023 runs PointTrack MOTS on UAV video, reports MOTSA, sMOTSA and ID switches, and counts berries per bunch in individual images. It also releases two datasets. It is C1, M3+DATA, V.

keputusan.jawaban: In a C1 record that already has an association mechanism (M2, M3, M4 or M5), a visible-to-true calibration regression is not labelled M1. It corrects occlusion (missed fruit), not double counting, and should be recorded in the evidence or notes for RQ2. M1 is given only when the statistical step is what handles the overlap between images. That is the case when per-image counts are combined without any fruit-level linking (see 1.1 b).
keputusan.aturan: Add M1 only if no M2-M5 linking exists and counts from several images are combined by a factor or regression; if M2-M5 is present, do not add M1 for an occlusion or visible-to-true calibration, and note the calibration in the evidence field.
keputusan.alasan: For M1 only when it handles overlap: the protocol defines the mechanism field as 'how the same fruit is prevented from being counted twice'. An occlusion calibration after deduplication does not do this. It addresses missed fruit, which RQ2 tracks as a separate outcome. Labelling M1 for every calibration would put M1 on most yield papers and blur the comparison of mechanisms in RQ1 and RQ2. Against 'always add M1': this is simpler, but it mixes two error sources (duplicates and occlusion) into one label. Against 'never M1': this contradicts the protocol's own M1 examples ('multiplier factor or regression') when such a factor is the only control of overlap. Checks against the examples: nuske2014 registers berries with visual odometry to avoid double counting (M4) and adds a visibility calibration, so it is M4 only. genemola2020fruit merges georeferenced LiDAR point clouds from both sides (M4) and adds a linear yield regression, so it is M4 only. apoloapolo2020 counts on a UAV orthomosaic (M4 per 1.1) and adds a linear regression because only part of each tree is visible from above, so it is M4 only.

keputusan.jawaban: Use S whenever fruit are detected or counted in a fused 3D representation (point cloud, mesh, voxel or SLAM map, NeRF or 3DGS). It does not matter whether the 3D data came from photogrammetry of discrete images, from video frames, or from a moving LiDAR or RGB-D scanner. Use V when 2D detections are linked or counted along a continuous path without a fused 3D model, including panoramas stitched from video. Use D when discrete images from separate positions are combined without a fused 3D model (statistical combination, triangulation of matched detections, 2D orthomosaics). Add T when the same plants are revisited at different times.
keputusan.aturan: If the count or detection is made in a 3D point cloud or 3D model, label S; else if it is made from frames of a continuous path, label V; else if it is made from discrete images at separate positions (including a 2D orthomosaic), label D; add +T for revisits over time.
keputusan.alasan: For S: the S definition literally includes 'point cloud', so a photogrammetric cloud fits it as well as a LiDAR scan. The association assumptions that RQ1 asks about are the same in both cases: a static scene, enough overlap for registration, and counting in 3D space (M4). Splitting them by sensor would separate records whose mechanism is identical. Against D for photogrammetry: D describes the capture but hides the fact that identity is resolved in 3D. Against V: many SfM or SLAM inputs are video, so V would depend on the capture format rather than the association step. A rule based on what the count runs on needs no judgement call and stays tied to the mechanism. Checks against the examples: xiao2024 builds a UAV cross-circling oblique point cloud and counts cotton bolls in it, so it is S. torressanchez2021 detects grape clusters in UAV photogrammetric point clouds, so it is S. hobart2025 detects apples in a UAV RGB dense point cloud and adds a multi-season campaign, so it is S, with +T only if the same trees are compared across seasons. genemola2020fuji is an SfM cloud from a motion sequence, so it is S.

keputusan.jawaban: Assess the ten pending records on content, as was done for the 27. E7 applies only when no English title and abstract are available for screening, as in the one existing E7 record. Records that pass screening are coded from the English abstract. For C1 labels, read the Chinese full text (machine translation is allowed). If a label cannot be read from it, record it as unclear rather than excluding the record.
keputusan.aturan: Apply E7 only when the record has no English title or no English abstract; a Chinese full text with an English abstract indexed in Scopus is screened and coded on content like any English record.
keputusan.alasan: For assessing on content: consistency is the deciding factor. 27 records from the same two journals are already included on this basis (11 of them are core C1), and E7 has so far been used only for an abstract available only in Chinese. Excluding the ten new records as E7 would apply two different rules to the same kind of source and bias the map against Chinese engineering work. That work is a large part of the C1 core and is relevant to RQ1 and RQ2. Screening uses titles and abstracts, which are in English and indexed, so the E7 purpose (records that cannot be screened) does not apply. Against E7 by full-text language: this reading is possible from the bare words 'language other than English'. It would force re-exclusion of the 27 records and the loss of 11 C1 records, which contradicts the established practice.
